qualities.detail: As a boy in Shiganshina he says that people content to live inside the Walls are no better than livestock, and he is set on joining the Survey Corps however much his mother objects.
After a Titan eats his mother in front of him when the Wall falls, he swears to destroy every Titan, and that oath is why he enlists.
He keeps flipping upside down in the cadets' balance test, asks classmates for tips, and tries again; even with damaged gear he manages to stay upright.
In his first battle at Trost he throws Armin clear of a Titan's mouth and is swallowed himself.
He charges at danger before weighing the odds, from facing armed kidnappers as a child to diving into Titan fights with almost no experience.

eren-jager.backstory: Eren grew up in Shiganshina, on the outer rim of Wall Maria, the son of the doctor Grisha Yeager and his wife Carla. His friend Armin fed his curiosity about what lay beyond the Walls. A year before the story begins, Eren went along on one of his father's doctor's visits and discovered that kidnappers had taken Mikasa Ackerman; he killed two of them, Mikasa killed the third, and she came to live with his family. In 845 the Colossal Titan smashed the outer gate, and Eren could only watch as a smiling Titan ate Carla. Soon afterwards Grisha gave him the key to the family basement and injected him with a serum, leaving him with only blurry memories. It later emerges that the injection turned him into a Titan who devoured his father and took his powers. In 847 he joined the 104th Training Corps with Mikasa and Armin.

journey.summary: Powerless when the Wall falls, Eren turns his grief into one goal: join the Survey Corps and kill Titans. Through stubbornness rather than natural talent, he graduates fifth in the 104th Training Corps.

Swallowed while saving Armin, he bursts out of the Titan as a Titan himself. After losing control on his first attempt, he carries a boulder to seal Trost's broken gate, humanity's first real victory, and is then placed in Captain Levi's squad.

The Female Titan hunts him outside the Walls, and he later beats her and learns she is his classmate Annie. Reiner and Bertholdt then turn out to be the Armored Titan and the Colossal Titan, and they kidnap him, and during his rescue he briefly commands other Titans for the first time.

Rod Reiss captures him and reveals that Grisha took the Founding Titan by force from the Reiss family, who had held it for generations, and handed it to Eren at the cost of his own life. Convinced he is worthless, Eren is ready to be eaten, but Historia refuses her father's plan and Eren is freed.

The Survey Corps retakes Wall Maria at a terrible cost, and Grisha's basement reveals that Paradis is an island, that its people are Eldians feared by the outside world, and that Marley is the real enemy. Eren learns he has only about eight years to live and finally reaches the sea, but his mind is on the enemies beyond it.

Four years later, Eren is in Liberio under the alias Mr. Kruger, posing as a wounded soldier. When Willy Tybur declares war on Paradis, Eren attacks the festival, kills Willy and takes the War Hammer Titan. Back home, he breaks with the island's leaders, backed by soldiers loyal to him who become known as the Yeagerists.

journey.stage: War for Paradis and the Rumbling (The Final Season, Final Chapters)
journey.summary: Eren gains command over everything the Founding Titan can do and frees the Colossal Titans sealed inside the Walls, sending them across the world. His friends join forces with their former enemies to stop him, and Mikasa ends it by beheading him after about 80% of the world's population has died. With his death the power of the Titans disappears (manga chapters 138-139, 2021; anime Final Chapters Special 2, 2023).

lessons.lesson: Anger can drive you, but it can't tell you where to go.
lessons.why: Rage over his mother's death gets Eren through training and Trost. By the Rumbling, the same refusal to accept any limit leads him to wipe out most of humanity.

lessons.lesson: Feeling worthless is not the same as being worthless.
lessons.why: Held prisoner by Rod Reiss, Eren decides his life is only a debt to repay and is ready to be eaten. It is Historia who refuses that role and gets him out, not his own reasoning.

lessons.lesson: Hiding your plans from the people closest to you still hurts them.
lessons.why: From the Marley arc on, Eren keeps Mikasa and Armin in the dark about his plans, and in the final battle they end up fighting him.

relationships.name: Mikasa Ackerman
relationships.detail: The Yeagers took Mikasa in after nine-year-old Eren helped save her from the men who murdered her parents. She stays fiercely protective of him from then on.

relationships.name: Armin Arlert
relationships.detail: Armin shares Eren's dream of seeing what lies beyond the Walls, and his quick thinking gets Eren out of trouble again and again.

relationships.name: Carla Yeager
relationships.detail: Pinned under their wrecked house when Shiganshina falls, Carla is eaten by a Titan as Eren is carried away. Her death is what drives his oath to destroy every Titan.

relationships.name: Levi
relationships.detail: After the military tribunal over Eren's Titan power, Levi takes him into his Special Operations Squad, which is tasked with guarding him.

relationships.name: Grisha Yeager
relationships.detail: Grisha injected Eren with Titan serum and let his son devour him, handing down the Titan powers he had taken from the royal Reiss family. Eren only recovers this memory in season 3.

relationships.name: Reiner Braun
relationships.detail: Reiner trained beside Eren in the 104th Cadet Corps, then revealed that he is the Armored Titan who smashed through Wall Maria's gate.

relationships.name: Zeke Yeager
relationships.detail: Zeke, the Beast Titan, is Grisha's son from his earlier life in Marley. The brothers work together to reach the Founding Titan's power, then turn on each other over how to use it.

fights.title: Sealing the gate at Trost
fights.summary: With the Garrison's elite squad and his fellow cadets holding off Titans, Eren's Titan drags a giant boulder across the district and plugs the hole in Wall Rose.

fights.title: Eren vs. the Female Titan in Stohess
fights.summary: The rematch with Annie tears through the Stohess District and ends at Wall Sina, where she shuts herself inside a hardened crystal before she can be taken.

fights.title: Eren vs. the Armored Titan
fights.summary: Eren turns the grappling moves he learned in training against Reiner and gains the upper hand, until the Colossal Titan's blast of steam stops the fight.

fights.title: Holding the Armored Titan in Shiganshina
fights.summary: Acting as bait, Eren trades punches with Reiner using his hardened hands, creating the opening Hange's and Levi's squads need to hit the Armored Titan with Thunder Spears.

fights.title: Seizing the War Hammer Titan
fights.summary: Unable to break Lara Tybur's crystal himself, Eren forces the Jaw Titan's teeth to crack it and swallows her, gaining the War Hammer Titan.

fights.title: Reaching Ymir in the Paths
fights.summary: Eren breaks loose before Zeke can use the Founder's power and tells Ymir she is free to choose; she sides with him, the Walls crumble and the Rumbling begins.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: the Colossal Titan breaches Shiganshina and Eren watches a Titan kill his mother.
Swallowed during the fight for Trost, Eren bursts out of the Titan as a Titan himself.
Historia's touch brings back Eren's buried memory of being turned into a Titan by Grisha.
In Liberio, Eren reveals himself to Reiner and transforms the moment Willy Tybur finishes declaring war.
Eren wins Ymir over in the Paths and the Rumbling starts.
Final Chapters Special 2: the last battle, where Mikasa ends the Rumbling by killing Eren.

strength.rank: Holder of the Attack, Founding and War Hammer Titans
strength.summary: Eren fights as a 15-metre Titan driven by sheer aggression, and in season 3 he learns hardening, which lets him armour his fists and build crystal structures. During the Liberio raid he swallows the War Hammer Titan's holder, and once he gains control of the Founding Titan he wakes the Colossal Titans inside the Walls and starts the Rumbling.

qualities.detail: He calls himself the strongest and proves it on arrival: when Sukuna takes over Yuji's body, Gojo subdues him almost casually.
When the jujutsu higher-ups sentence Yuji to death for hosting Sukuna, Gojo uses his influence to get the execution postponed.
Convinced the higher-ups arranged Yuji's death on an early mission, he has Shoko keep Yuji's revival quiet and starts training him in secret.
Ambushed by the curse Jogo, he fetches Yuji in a matter of seconds so the boy can watch a Domain Expansion up close, and turns the fight into a lesson.
Even at his most dangerous he jokes, teases and acts the clown with his students, which makes his rare serious moments land harder.

jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojou.backstory: Satoru was born into the Gojo Clan as the first person in four hundred years to inherit both the clan's Limitless technique and the Six Eyes. At Tokyo Jujutsu High he became close friends with his classmates Suguru Geto and Shoko Ieiri. As students, he and Geto were assigned to protect Riko Amanai, a girl chosen to be fused with Tengen, an undying sorcerer. The mercenary Toji Fushiguro beat them both and killed Riko; Gojo survived a lethal wound by grasping reverse cursed technique in the moment, then killed Toji. The mission shook Geto's faith in protecting non-sorcerers. He massacred a village and fled, and when Gojo confronted him, he could not bring himself to kill his best friend. Gojo went on to teach at Jujutsu High, and years later, in the prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0, he executed Geto after Geto's attack on Tokyo.

journey.summary: Gojo recruits Yuta Okkotsu, a student haunted by the cursed spirit Rika, and places him in a class with Maki, Toge and Panda so he can learn to control his curse and make friends. When Geto comes for Rika's power, Yuta leaves him gravely wounded, and Gojo carries out the execution of his old friend himself.
He gets Yuji's execution postponed, teaches Yuji, Megumi and Nobara, and hides Yuji's return from the dead from the higher-ups. Against Jogo he shows Yuji what a Domain Expansion can do.

When curses and curse users break into the exchange event, Gojo easily restrains one intruder and fires Hollow Purple at the special-grade curse Hanami, reminding everyone how far ahead of them he is.
A flashback to his school days: the failed mission to protect Riko, his near death and awakening against Toji, and the slow break with Geto that ends with Gojo letting him walk away.

Gojo goes into Shibuya alone to protect trapped civilians and exorcises Hanami. Then Kenjaku appears wearing Geto's body; the sight freezes Gojo with old memories just long enough for Kenjaku to trap him in the Prison Realm.

Freed by his students, he calls Sukuna out, and in their Christmas Eve fight he comes close to winning before Sukuna kills him (chapter 236). He is last seen talking with Geto and other dead friends at a dreamlike airport, and Yuta later uses Gojo's body in the final fight against Sukuna. The anime has not reached these chapters as of November 2026.

lessons.lesson: Stand up for the people everyone else has written off.
lessons.why: Gojo blocks execution orders for both Yuta and Yuji, betting that support and training will make 'dangerous' students into allies. In the end, both are central to defeating Sukuna.

lessons.lesson: Being the strongest doesn't protect you from your feelings.
lessons.why: In Shibuya, nothing Kenjaku throws at Gojo works until it shows him his dead friend's face, and a moment's hesitation is enough to seal him.

lessons.lesson: Some people can't be stopped by power alone.
lessons.why: As a student, Gojo could beat anyone, yet he couldn't keep Geto from turning on non-sorcerers, and he couldn't bring himself to stop Geto when they met.

relationships.name: Yuji Itadori
relationships.detail: Gojo persuades the jujutsu higher-ups to put off Yuji's execution so he can eat all of Sukuna's fingers, then enrols him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

relationships.name: Megumi Fushiguro
relationships.detail: Gojo has looked out for Megumi since he was a young boy and now teaches him at Jujutsu High; recalling Gojo's advice is what pushes Megumi to unlock his own Domain Expansion.

relationships.name: Nobara Kugisaki
relationships.detail: Gojo brings Nobara in as the third first-year and takes the new trio on their first training mission.

relationships.name: Sukuna
relationships.detail: When Sukuna first seizes Yuji's body, Gojo subdues him without breaking a sweat, then proposes that Yuji absorb every finger so the curse can be wiped out with him.

relationships.name: Suguru Geto
relationships.detail: Geto was Gojo's classmate and partner at Jujutsu High until he lost faith in protecting non-sorcerers and became a curse user. The sight of his face later lets the enemy catch Gojo off guard in Shibuya.

relationships.name: Toji Fushiguro
relationships.detail: The cursed-energy-free assassin nearly kills teenage Gojo during the Star Plasma Vessel mission; Gojo survives by mastering Reverse Cursed Technique and kills him with Hollow Purple.

relationships.name: Shoko Ieiri
relationships.detail: Shoko studied in the same year as Gojo and Geto and now works as the school's doctor.

fights.title: Testing Sukuna
fights.summary: Gojo arrives to find Sukuna in control of Yuji and casually overpowers him to see whether the boy can keep the curse in check.

fights.title: Gojo vs. Jogo
fights.summary: With Yuji watching, Gojo shows off Infinity, counters Jogo's domain with Unlimited Void and takes the curse's head off.

fights.title: Ambushed by Toji Fushiguro
fights.summary: Worn down from two days of guarding Riko, Gojo is caught from behind by Toji, whose cursed tool cuts through his technique and leaves him for dead.

fights.title: Gojo vs. Toji, round two
fights.summary: Healed by his first use of Reverse Cursed Technique, Gojo tracks Toji down and unleashes Hollow Purple for the first time.

fights.title: The 0.2-second domain in Shibuya
fights.summary: Surrounded by curses and a crowd of civilians, Gojo opens Unlimited Void for just 0.2 seconds and wipes out a thousand transfigured humans, only to be caught by the Prison Realm.

keyEpisodes.why: Gojo steps in for Yuji, delays his death sentence and recruits him to Jujutsu High.
The first full look at Infinity and Unlimited Void in his fight with Jogo.
Hidden Inventory begins, showing Gojo as a second-year student alongside Geto and Shoko.
Gojo awakens Reverse Cursed Technique and Hollow Purple, the turning point in his growth.
The Prison Realm finishes sealing Gojo, leaving the Shibuya Incident to his students.

ages.when: Main story (from the start of the series)

strength.rank: Strongest jujutsu sorcerer of his era
strength.summary: Gojo pairs the Limitless technique, which stops attacks just short of his body, with the Six Eyes, which read cursed energy in fine detail. The special-grade curse Jogo never lands a hit on him and is overwhelmed once Gojo opens his Domain Expansion, Unlimited Void; earlier, Gojo subdues Sukuna in Yuji's body with ease.

qualities.detail: He sets out alone in a small boat telling everyone he meets that he's going to be King of the Pirates, and he talks about it as a certainty, not a hope.
He wears Shanks's straw hat everywhere because he promised to hand it back once he'd grown into a great pirate.
When Coby tells him about the captured pirate hunter Zoro, Luffy decides on the spot to make him his first crewmate, trusting his own read of people over their reputations.
When Nami finally asks for help against Arlong, he places his treasured straw hat on her head, then goes straight to Arlong Park.
At the Baratie he watches Zoro face Mihawk without interfering, and accepts Zoro's tearful promise afterwards never to lose again.

luffy-monkey-d.backstory: Luffy grew up in Windmill Village in the Goa Kingdom, a quiet corner of the East Blue where the Red-Haired Pirates often stopped. He idolised their captain, Shanks, and begged to sail with them. After he accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Fruit, his body became rubber and he lost the ability to swim. When a Sea King attacked him, Shanks saved him and lost his left arm doing it, then left him the straw hat, to be returned when Luffy had made his name as a pirate. Luffy's grandfather, the Marine Garp, then placed him with the mountain bandit Curly Dadan, where he grew up with Ace and Sabo as sworn brothers; Sabo was apparently killed by a World Noble. Ten years after meeting Shanks, Luffy set sail to find the One Piece. Much later he learns that his father is the revolutionary leader Monkey D. Dragon.

journey.summary: Luffy gathers Zoro, Nami, Usopp and Sanji, gets the Going Merry, and beats Buggy, Don Krieg and Arlong. Freeing Nami's village from Arlong earns him his first bounty.

In the Grand Line he agrees to take Princess Vivi home and stop the warlord Crocodile's plot against her kingdom, picking up the reindeer doctor Chopper on the way. He defeats Crocodile, but the government hides his part in it, and Crocodile's former partner Nico Robin joins the crew.

He ends a centuries-old war in Skypiea by defeating Eneru. When Robin is taken by CP9, the crew storms the government's judicial island of Enies Lobby, declares war on the World Government to get her back, and gains the shipwright Franky.

After Kuma scatters the crew, Luffy breaks into Impel Down and then fights in the war at Marineford to save his brother Ace, who dies shielding him from Admiral Akainu. Jinbe pulls him out of his grief by asking what he still has, Luffy answers that he has his crew, and he decides they will all train for two years before reuniting.

journey.stage: Fish-Man Island to Whole Cake Island
journey.summary: Reunited, the crew saves Fish-Man Island from Hody Jones. Allied with Trafalgar Law, Luffy brings down Doflamingo in Dressrosa, where seven crews pledge themselves to him as the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He then raids Big Mom's territory to bring Sanji back and defeats her commander Katakuri.

Leading an alliance of samurai, minks and pirates, he fights Kaido in round after round. After an apparently fatal blow, his Devil Fruit awakens and is revealed to be the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika; as Gear Fifth he beats Kaido, frees Wano, and is named one of the Four Emperors.

After Wano the crew reaches Egghead, where they are caught up in the World Government's attack on the scientist Vegapunk. The story is still running as of November 2026, and Luffy's dream remains unfinished.

lessons.lesson: Asking for help takes courage too.
lessons.why: Nami spends years trying to buy back her village alone. It is only when she finally asks Luffy for help that Arlong's hold on the village is broken.

lessons.lesson: In the worst moments, count what you still have.
lessons.why: After Ace's death Luffy is ready to give up, until Jinbe makes him name what he still has and he answers: his crew.

lessons.lesson: Some dreams are your friend's to chase, not yours.
lessons.why: Luffy doesn't step in when Zoro faces Mihawk at the Baratie, even though Zoro is badly outmatched; the duel belongs to Zoro's ambition.

lessons.lesson: Choose people for who they are, not for their reputation.
lessons.why: Luffy makes up his mind to recruit Zoro, a captured pirate hunter Coby is nervous about, before meeting him, and he keeps faith in Nami even after she sails off with the Going Merry and their treasure.

relationships.name: Shanks
relationships.detail: When Luffy was seven, Shanks gave up an arm to pull him away from a sea king, and he left Luffy the straw hat that becomes his trademark.

relationships.name: Roronoa Zoro
relationships.detail: Luffy finds the bounty hunter tied up at a Marine base, hands him back his three swords, and Zoro signs on as the first Straw Hat.

relationships.name: Nami
relationships.detail: Luffy refuses to give up on Nami even after she appears to betray the crew; once he brings down Arlong, who had held her village captive, she joins for good.

relationships.name: Portgas D. Ace
relationships.detail: Ace, a Whitebeard Pirates commander, is the brother Luffy grew up with. Luffy storms Marineford to save him, but Ace dies in his arms after taking Admiral Akainu's blow.

relationships.name: Monkey D. Garp
relationships.detail: Luffy's grandfather is a celebrated Marine vice admiral, which puts the family on opposite sides of the law.

relationships.name: Monkey D. Dragon
relationships.detail: Luffy's father leads the Revolutionary Army, the world's most wanted rebel group.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Arlong
fights.summary: Furious at the years Nami spent drawing charts for Arlong, Luffy finishes the fish-man and wrecks Arlong Park, freeing her village.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Crocodile, final round
fights.summary: After two losses to the sand-wielding Warlord, Luffy wins their third clash beneath Alabasta's capital, driving Crocodile up through solid rock.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Rob Lucci
fights.summary: Spurred back to his feet by Usopp, Luffy outlasts the CP9 assassin at Enies Lobby and finishes him with Jet Gatling.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Doflamingo
fights.summary: Breaking free of Doflamingo's strings with Gear Fourth, Luffy smashes through the Warlord's defences with King Kong Gun and frees Dressrosa.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Katakuri
fights.summary: Their long duel in the Mirro-World ends with Katakuri falling on his back, and Luffy covers the commander's mouth with a hat as a show of respect.

fights.title: Luffy vs. Kaido
fights.summary: In Gear 5, Luffy lands one last giant punch that drives Kaido underground and ends the Beast Pirates' hold on Wano.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: Luffy tells Coby his dream of becoming the Pirate King.
Flashback to how Luffy ate the Gum-Gum Fruit and why Shanks's straw hat matters so much to him.
Ace dies at Marineford protecting Luffy, the lowest point of his journey.
Two years later, Luffy leaves his training island to reunite with the crew at Sabaody.
Luffy rises again on Onigashima and unlocks Gear 5.

ages.when: Setting out to sea (start of the series)

strength.rank: A new Emperor of the Sea
strength.summary: Luffy's rubber body, combined with Armament and Observation Haki and his Gear forms, lets him topple Warlords such as Crocodile and Doflamingo and Big Mom's top commander Katakuri. In Wano his Devil Fruit awakens into Gear 5, he beats Kaido, and his bounty rises to 3 billion berries as the world ranks him among the Four Emperors.

qualities.detail: Tied to a post in a Marine base yard, he can't stop a little girl from bringing him homemade rice balls, so he has Luffy feed them to him and makes sure she hears that he enjoyed them.
Everything he does serves one goal, becoming the world's greatest swordsman, a promise he made as a child to his rival Kuina.
Badly outclassed by Mihawk at the Baratie, he refuses to back out of the duel, and once it is over he apologises to Luffy and swears not to lose again until he has beaten Mihawk.
Still bleeding from Buggy's sneak attack in Orange Town, he takes on Buggy's swordsman Cabaji anyway and wins.
He gets lost constantly; his whole career as a bounty hunter began because he lost his way while searching for Mihawk.

zoro-roronoa.backstory: Zoro grew up in the East Blue and joined a sword dojo after losing to Kuina, the teacher's daughter, whom he never managed to beat. When she said that one day he would surpass her simply because she was a girl, he was furious at her giving up, and the two promised each other that one of them would reach the top as the world's greatest swordsman. Kuina died in an accident soon afterwards, and Zoro took on the promise for both of them. He set out to find the strongest swordsman, Dracule Mihawk, got lost, and spent years hunting pirates for bounties alongside Johnny and Yosaku. By the time Luffy meets him, he is a captive at a Marine base for crossing the commander's son, Helmeppo. Volume 105 later revealed that both his parents died when he was young and that he descends from Wano's Shimotsuki family.

journey.summary: Rescued by Luffy at the Marine base, he becomes the first Straw Hat, on the condition that his own ambition comes first. His crushing loss to Mihawk at the Baratie turns that ambition into a specific rematch he trains toward from then on.
Against Mr. 1 (Daz Bonez), who can turn his body into steel, Zoro learns to cut steel in the middle of the fight and wins, earning his first bounty of 60 million berries.

When Usopp quits after his fight with Luffy, Zoro refuses to let him back without an apology, treating it as a matter of the captain's authority. After the crew's raid on Enies Lobby, his bounty rises to 120 million.
When Kuma scatters the crew, Zoro lands near Mihawk and swallows his pride to train under the man who beat him, spending the next two years there.
Back with the crew, he defeats one of Doflamingo's top officers, a giant opponent, and helps Luffy end Doflamingo's rule; his bounty climbs to 320 million.

Given the legendary sword Enma, he joins the raid on Onigashima and defeats King, Kaido's right-hand man, pushing his bounty past one billion berries. The story is ongoing in the manga and anime as of November 2026, and his rematch with Mihawk has not happened yet.

lessons.lesson: A loss can be a starting point.
lessons.why: Zoro's duel with Mihawk is a humiliating defeat, but he immediately promises Luffy that he won't lose again, and that defeat becomes the goal he trains toward.

lessons.lesson: Pride should bend when your goal needs it to.
lessons.why: Stranded near Mihawk during the timeskip, Zoro asks the man who beat him to train him, because he cares more about the goal than about his ego.

lessons.lesson: Small kindnesses deserve respect.
lessons.why: Starving and tied up, Zoro still makes sure the girl who risked trouble to feed him knows that her rice balls were good.

lessons.lesson: Loyalty sometimes means drawing a hard line.
lessons.why: When Usopp wants to come back after quitting, Zoro insists he apologise first, because welcoming him back as if nothing had happened would undermine Luffy as captain.

relationships.name: Monkey D. Luffy
relationships.detail: Luffy recruits Zoro off a Marine execution post, making him the very first Straw Hat after Luffy himself.

relationships.name: Kuina
relationships.detail: Zoro joined the dojo after losing to Kuina, his teacher's daughter, and never managed to beat her. Soon after the two swore that one of them would reach the top as the world's best swordsman, she died, so he carries the vow for both.

relationships.name: Dracule Mihawk
relationships.detail: The world's greatest swordsman easily beats Zoro at the Baratie but sees promise in him, and Zoro swears he will not lose again until their rematch.

relationships.name: Sanji
relationships.detail: Zoro and Sanji bicker over almost anything and trade nicknames instead of names, yet together with Luffy they form the crew's 'Monster Trio'.

relationships.name: Johnny and Yosaku
relationships.detail: Before meeting Luffy, Zoro tracked down pirates for bounties alongside this pair, and Johnny turns up again shortly after Zoro joins the crew.

relationships.name: Dracule Mihawk (two-year timeskip)
relationships.detail: After the crew is scattered, Zoro spends the two-year timeskip training under the rival he swore to surpass.

fights.title: Zoro vs. Mihawk at the Baratie
fights.summary: Zoro challenges the world's greatest swordsman and is outclassed, then vows to Luffy that he will never lose again.

fights.title: Zoro vs. Mr. 1
fights.summary: Badly wounded by the steel-bodied Baroque Works agent, Zoro learns to sense the rhythm in all things and cuts him down with a single slash.

fights.title: Zoro vs. Kaku
fights.summary: Pushed to the edge by CP9's giraffe-powered swordsman at Enies Lobby, Zoro unveils Asura and wins.

fights.title: Taking Luffy's pain on Thriller Bark
fights.summary: With Luffy unconscious, Zoro agrees to absorb all of his captain's pain from Bartholomew Kuma so the crew can be spared.

fights.title: Zoro vs. King
fights.summary: Wielding Enma with Conqueror's Haki, Zoro reveals a new 'King of Hell' style and defeats Kaido's right-hand man.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: Luffy finds Zoro tied to a post at the Marine base.
Flashback to Kuina and the promise behind Zoro's dream.
His crushing loss to Mihawk, which shapes everything he does afterwards.
Zoro's sacrifice for Luffy against Kuma on Thriller Bark.
Zoro's win over King, the high point of his Wano arc.

strength.rank: Straw Hats' top swordsman and one of the 'Monster Trio'
strength.summary: Zoro fights with three swords at once, learns to cut steel against Mr. 1 in Alabasta, and later unlocks his Asura technique to beat CP9's Kaku. In Wano he channels Armament and Conqueror's Haki through his blades to defeat King, one of Kaido's top commanders, and his bounty climbs to 1,111,000,000 berries.

qualities.detail: In the middle of chasing the thief who took her royal insignia, she stops to rescue Subaru, a total stranger, from three thugs in an alley.
When she first meets Subaru she gives her name as Satella, the name of the feared Witch of Envy, as if to warn him off before he can reject her for being a half-elf.
After the royal selection hall, she tells Subaru that a half-elf like her doesn't deserve to be happy, and assumes his help must really serve some purpose of his own.
When the maids are busy, she steps in to teach Subaru to read and write, and she takes promises seriously enough to be hurt when he breaks his word and turns up at the royal hall.
Half-elves and other outcasts in Lugunica see her bid for the throne as a sign that the country could treat them fairly.

emilia-3.backstory: Emilia was raised in the Elior Forest by Fortuna, whom she called Mother, in a community of elves. The Witch Cult's Petelgeuse, then a gentle friend, visited regularly and kept asking about a mysterious 'seal' in the forest. When Regulus Corneas and the Witch of Vanity, Pandora, came for that seal, Fortuna was killed defending Emilia, and the girl's grief made her magic run out of control until the entire forest, and the people living in it, were frozen. Pandora wiped her memories before she too fell into a long frozen sleep. About a century later the spirit Puck found her in the ice, and the two lived in isolation until Roswaal took them in and backed her as a candidate for the throne. Her hidden goal is to free the people still frozen in the forest. Because she resembles the Witch of Envy, most people shun her.

journey.summary: Felt steals the insignia she needs to compete for the throne, and Emilia meets Subaru while trying to get it back. In loops he alone remembers, she is killed several times, but in the timeline that holds, the insignia is recovered and she brings the wounded Subaru to Roswaal's mansion to heal him.

Emilia warms to Subaru while he works as a servant at the mansion, unaware that he is reliving days again and again to save the household. She heals him more than once and agrees to a date in the village.

At the royal hall she is criticised for being a half-elf, and Subaru's outburst as her self-proclaimed knight embarrasses her. Their argument afterwards ends their friendship, but once he has rescued her and the villagers from the Witch Cult, she cries with joy when he tells her he loves her.

Trapped by the Sanctuary's barrier, which only a half-breed can break by passing its trials, she fails at first while Puck is absent. Once Puck reveals that their contract had been suppressing her memories, she faces the truth about Fortuna and the frozen forest, passes the trials, breaks the barrier and later knights Subaru as her own.

When the Witch Cult attacks the water city, the Archbishop of Greed, Regulus, takes her to be his next wife. She works out that his wives are tied to his invincibility, persuades them to turn on him, and helps Subaru and Reinhard defeat him.
The light novels continue her story past the point the anime has adapted, and the royal selection is still undecided as of November 2026.

lessons.lesson: Confronting your past is hard, but avoiding it keeps you stuck.
lessons.why: Emilia fails the Sanctuary's first trial until she lets herself relive Fortuna's death and the frozen forest, and only then can she pass and lead.

lessons.lesson: Helping someone shouldn't depend on what you get back.
lessons.why: On the day she meets Subaru she has every reason to keep running after her stolen insignia, but she stops to help a stranger in trouble.

lessons.lesson: Doubting your own worth makes it hard to trust anyone else's care.
lessons.why: Her belief that a half-elf doesn't deserve happiness leads her to assume Subaru must have selfish motives, and the argument that follows costs them their friendship for a while.

relationships.name: Subaru Natsuki
relationships.detail: Emilia rescues Subaru on his first day in the new world, and he becomes devoted to her, even proclaiming himself her knight in front of the royal court.

relationships.name: Puck
relationships.detail: The cat-shaped spirit fights at her side and watches over her; if Emilia dies, he turns into a colossal beast that destroys everything around him.

relationships.name: Roswaal L. Mathers
relationships.detail: The eccentric court mage backs Emilia's bid for the throne and gives her a home at his mansion.

relationships.name: Felt
relationships.detail: The slum thief who swipes Emilia's insignia in the first episode is later revealed as another candidate in the royal selection.

relationships.name: Fortuna
relationships.detail: Mother Fortuna raised Emilia in Elior Forest. Reliving Fortuna's death in the Sanctuary trial shows Emilia how she came to freeze the whole forest.

relationships.name: Regulus Corneas
relationships.detail: The Sin Archbishop of Greed abducts Emilia in Priestella intending to marry her, but she turns his captive wives against him.

fights.title: Emilia and Puck vs. Elsa
fights.summary: At the loot house, Emilia and Puck combine ice attacks against Elsa until Puck runs out of time, and Subaru takes a blow meant for her.

fights.title: The royal selection hearing
fights.summary: Facing scorn at court for being a half-elf, Emilia watches Subaru insult the knights by naming himself her knight, a moment that strains their relationship.

fights.title: The Elior Forest memory
fights.summary: In her trial, Emilia relives Pandora's attack and Fortuna's death, and the grief that made her magic freeze the forest.

fights.title: Stopping the Great Rabbit
fights.summary: Emilia joins forces with Subaru and his newly contracted spirit Beatrice to trap the swarm of Great Rabbits threatening the Sanctuary.

fights.title: Emilia vs. Sirius
fights.summary: Emilia insists on helping Subaru and Beatrice in Priestella and fights the Archbishop of Wrath, who catches her off guard with a hostage.

fights.title: Breaking Regulus's hold
fights.summary: Emilia wins over Regulus's wives and puts them into icy sleep instead of letting them die, leaving him open for Reinhard to finish.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: she saves Subaru in an alley while calling herself 'Satella'.
She finally tells Subaru her real name, Emilia.
The royal selection begins and Emilia's half-elf heritage is attacked in public.
Emilia clears the final trial and lifts the barrier holding the Sanctuary's residents.
Subaru officially becomes Emilia's knight in a formal ceremony.

strength.rank: Spirit-arts user with formidable ice magic
strength.summary: Emilia fights with ice spells; with Puck beside her she has the upper hand on the assassin Elsa until night forces Puck to retreat. The Sanctuary trial reveals that as a grieving child she froze all of Elior Forest, and she later helps trap the Great Rabbit swarm and faces the Sin Archbishops Sirius and Regulus in Priestella.

qualities.detail: A quiet literature student who spends his free time reading, he has just one close friend, the outgoing Hide.
After becoming a half-ghoul he holds out against eating human flesh for as long as he can, unwilling to become a monster but no longer able to live as a human.
Barely in control of his new body, he still fights the ghoul Nishiki to stop him from eating Hide.
He happily spends time with the polished ghoul Tsukiyama, never suspecting that the friendship is bait for a plan to eat him.
Fighting the investigator Amon, he realises he may be the only one who understands what both humans and ghouls are going through, and tells Amon to get away instead of finishing him.

ken-kaneki.backstory: When the story opens, Ken Kaneki is an eighteen-year-old student of Japanese literature at Kamii University: shy, gentle and happiest with a book. Apart from his loud best friend Hideyoshi 'Hide' Nagachika, he keeps mostly to himself. He falls for Rize Kamishiro, a soft-spoken young woman in glasses, and is thrilled when she agrees to a date. On the way home she lures him into a quiet spot and reveals herself as a ghoul, but steel beams falling from a construction site crush her mid-attack. Kaneki, badly wounded, survives because Dr. Kanou operates on him at once and transplants some of Rize's organs into him. He wakes as a half-ghoul who cannot stomach normal food. Later, while being tortured by Yamori, he learns that Kanou made him a ghoul on purpose.

journey.summary: Kaneki struggles to adjust to his new hunger until he has to fight Nishiki to protect Hide. Yoshimura then takes him in at the Anteiku café, where he learns to pass as human, putting up with Touka's hostility at first.

He survives Tsukiyama's attempt to eat him with Touka's and Nishiki's help. After the investigator Mado kills Hinami's mother, he decides to stand up to the CCG, puts on the eyepatch mask made by Uta, and spares Amon after beating him, earning the nickname Eyepatch.
Yamori of Aogiri Tree kidnaps him and tortures him for days. In a vision of Rize he accepts his ghoul half; his hair turns white, and he breaks free and kills Yamori.

In the manga, a colder Kaneki forms his own group and eats other ghouls to grow stronger, turning partly into a kakuja known as Centipede, until the events at Kanou's lab make him regret that path. The anime's √A season tells an original story in which he joins Aogiri Tree instead.

After his defeat by Kishou Arima, Kaneki loses his memories and becomes Haise Sasaki, a CCG investigator who mentors the half-ghoul Quinx Squad. Haise fears the old self buried inside him, but when the CCG raids the Tsukiyama family his memories return and he accepts the name Kaneki again.
He breaks with the CCG to help Touka rescue Hinami from Cochlea, defeats Arima and claims the One-Eyed King title. He then founds Goat, a group meant to make peace between humans and ghouls.

journey.stage: The Dragon and after (Tokyo Ghoul:re finale)
journey.summary: Maimed in a brutal fight with Juzo, he devours the Oggai squad and swells into a monstrous mass of kagune that ravages the city. Touka and the Quinx Squad rescue him, he reunites with Hide, whom he had believed dead, and the series ends with Kaneki married to Touka with a daughter, while the CCG is replaced by a security force that includes both humans and ghouls (manga 2018; adapted in :re's second anime season).

lessons.lesson: Mercy is a choice you can make even in the middle of a fight.
lessons.why: Against Amon, Kaneki could finish the investigator off, but he lets him go because he sees there are people worth understanding on both sides.

lessons.lesson: Chasing strength to protect people can drive them away.
lessons.why: In the manga, Kaneki eats other ghouls to make sure no one he loves gets hurt again, but the harder he pushes, the further he drifts from the friends he wanted to protect.

lessons.lesson: A fresh start doesn't erase who you were.
lessons.why: As Haise Sasaki he builds a happy new life with the Quinx Squad, yet he can't stop his past from surfacing; he only finds stable ground once he accepts both identities.

relationships.name: Rize Kamishiro
relationships.detail: Rize lured Kaneki in to eat him; after the accident that followed, a surgeon gave him her organs, turning him half-ghoul, and she keeps resurfacing as a voice in his head.

relationships.name: Hideyoshi Nagachika
relationships.detail: Hide is the friend Kaneki first fights to protect as a ghoul. At the end of √A, Hide admits he had known Kaneki's secret all along.

relationships.name: Touka Kirishima
relationships.detail: Touka is hard on the newcomer at Anteiku at first but becomes his closest ally; in :re the two marry.

relationships.name: Yoshimura
relationships.detail: The owner of Anteiku takes Kaneki in and teaches him how a ghoul can live quietly among humans.

relationships.name: Koutarou Amon
relationships.detail: When Kaneki gets the better of the investigator in their first clash, he lets Amon go instead of eating him, and their paths keep crossing after that.

relationships.name: Kishou Arima
relationships.detail: The CCG's strongest investigator crushes Kaneki at the end of √A and later raises him as Haise Sasaki; their final duel in :re ends with Arima dying in Kaneki's arms.

fights.title: Kaneki vs. Nishiki
fights.summary: Still refusing to accept what he has become, Kaneki has to fight the ghoul Nishiki when he goes after Hide.

fights.title: Kaneki vs. Amon
fights.summary: Kaneki's kagune bursts out in his first fight with a CCG investigator, but he lets Amon escape rather than kill him.

fights.title: Breaking free from Yamori
fights.summary: After days of torture, Kaneki's hair turns white, he embraces his ghoul side, and he mortally wounds Yamori before eating his kagune.

fights.title: Facing Arima in the ruins of Anteiku
fights.summary: Carrying Hide's body, Kaneki walks out to confront Arima; by morning only Arima is left standing.

fights.title: The last duel with Arima
fights.summary: In Cochlea, Kaneki's fight with Arima ends with the Reaper dying in his arms and revealing the truth behind the One-Eyed King.

fights.title: Kaneki vs. Furuta
fights.summary: In the anime's final episode, Kaneki battles Furuta inside the Dragon and defeats him.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: Rize's attack and the organ transplant that make Kaneki half-ghoul.
Yoshimura takes him in at Anteiku, where he meets Touka.
Kaneki's white-haired awakening in Yamori's torture room.
He returns with no memories as Haise Sasaki, the CCG investigator who oversees the Quinx Squad.
Kaneki declares himself the One-Eyed King and founds the group Goat.

strength.rank: The One-Eyed King of :re
strength.summary: Kaneki's rinkaku kagune comes from Rize, and after Yamori's torture he breaks free and devours his captor's kagune. In :re he outlasts Kishou Arima, the CCG's strongest investigator, takes on the One-Eyed King mantle, and later turns into the city-sized 'Dragon' before defeating Furuta.

qualities.detail: When a pair of con artists accuse Mob of breaking an expensive vase, Reigen steps in and turns their own scam back on them.

Hired to look into urban legends, he shows that most 'supernatural' sightings have ordinary explanations, like the rumoured 'human-faced dog', which turns out to be someone's pet that children had doodled a face on.
He pays Mob 300 yen an hour, lets the boy do all the real exorcising, and happily takes the credit and the fee.
He has made Mob swear not to turn his powers on other people, and when Mob is pushed toward rage he tells him it's fine to run away rather than fight.
With no powers at all, he walks into Claw's Seventh Division to find Mob, and the guards end up mistaking him for their leader.

arataka-reigen.backstory: Reigen was once an ordinary company employee who quit to open his own business, the Spirits and Such Consultation Office, offering cheap psychic help. He has no psychic powers at all; what he has is a quick tongue, common sense and a talent for reading people. Business was poor, and he was close to giving up when a young Mob came to his office asking how to control his psychic abilities. Reigen intended to send him away with some improvised advice, but once he saw Mob's power for himself, he hired him as an assistant. Over the years that followed, Reigen became Mob's mentor, teaching him that his powers don't make him better than anyone else and getting him to promise never to use them against people. Mob's faith in him is a big part of why Reigen stayed in the business at all.

journey.summary: Reigen takes job after job, from an evil spirit in a client's home to a haunted tunnel, bluffing his way through while Mob handles the real ghosts. Even so, his advice often fixes the human side of a client's problem.

Tracking Mob's phone, he walks into Claw's base, frees Mob, Ritsu and Teru from a room that blocks their powers, and talks Mob down from rage. Running on power borrowed from Mob, he holds off the Scars on his own and tells them that espers are still just people.

Once his new website brings in more work, Reigen leans on Mob harder than ever. When Mob realises he has been exploited and ends their partnership, Reigen is left alone with his loneliness but keeps the office running.

A rival psychic group lures him onto live television and exposes him as a fake. At the hostile press conference that follows, he says on air that someone close to him has grown up, a message meant for Mob. Mob secretly lifts the cameras into the air, then tells Reigen he always knew he was a good person.

With Claw launching an all-out attack on the city, Reigen joins the alliance against them. He takes out the powerful esper Shimazaki largely by luck, and when Claw's leader, Toichiro Suzuki, moves to kill Mob, Reigen throws himself into the fight despite having no way to win.

When Mob's suppressed self tears through the city, Reigen pushes alone through the storm to reach him and admits he has no powers and has been using Mob. That honesty helps Mob accept every part of himself, and the series ends at Reigen's birthday party, surrounded by the people Mob brought into his life.

lessons.lesson: Running away is sometimes the right call.
lessons.why: At Claw's base, Reigen tells Mob to escape rather than fight, putting Mob's safety above pride or guilt.

lessons.lesson: Having no special talent doesn't make you less of a person.
lessons.why: Reigen reminds the Scars that espers are still human, and later admits his own lack of powers to Mob; both moments argue that power doesn't decide a person's worth.

lessons.lesson: Honesty can repair what using people broke.
lessons.why: Mob leaves when he realises Reigen has been exploiting him; what finally reaches him in the Season 3 finale is Reigen admitting the truth instead of bluffing.

lessons.lesson: Good advice often needs common sense, not magic.
lessons.why: Many of Reigen's 'cases' are solved by noticing the obvious, like the human-faced dog that was simply a doodle on a pet.

relationships.name: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama
relationships.detail: Reigen has the middle-school esper do the real exorcisms at his agency, Spirits and Such, while lecturing him that psychic power does not make anyone better than other people.

relationships.name: Dimple
relationships.detail: The spirit trails Mob after losing to him and trades barbs with Reigen; in the final arc he possesses Reigen so Reigen can reach a rampaging Mob.

relationships.name: Katsuya Serizawa
relationships.detail: Once Claw's leader's bodyguard, the powerful esper comes to work at Spirits and Such after Claw's world-domination bid collapses.

relationships.name: Kirin Jodo
relationships.detail: The head of a rival psychic group sets Reigen up on live television and exposes him as a fake.

fights.title: Salt Splash vs. an evil spirit
fights.summary: Reigen's handfuls of table salt only irritate the spirit, so he calls in Mob, who wipes it out in an instant.

fights.title: Taken for Claw's boss
fights.summary: Tracking Mob's phone to Claw's Seventh Division, Reigen gets mistaken for the organisation's leader and talks his way inside to free the captives.

fights.title: Reigen vs. the Scars
fights.summary: Powered by energy Mob unconsciously lends him, Reigen shrugs off the Scars' attacks, beats Ishiguro and tells the espers they are still just people.

fights.title: The press conference
fights.summary: Exposed as a fraud on TV, Reigen faces a hostile press conference and tells Mob, through the cameras, that he has grown up.

fights.title: Confessing to Mob
fights.summary: Walking into Mob's runaway ???% state, Reigen admits he has no powers and convinces Mob to accept every part of himself.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: the self-styled psychic and his secret weapon, Mob, at work.
Reigen's stand against the Scars, the payoff of his advice to Mob.
Mob realises he has been used and walks away from the agency, leaving Reigen alone.
Reigen's public downfall and the press conference that wins Mob back.
The series finale, built around Reigen's honesty with Mob.

qualities.detail: At 18 she already has research published in Science, and she is the one who works out that the lab's jellied bananas are matter crushed while passing through a micro black hole.
She embarrasses Okabe in public with a lecture on why time travel is unlikely, and stays in denial about the PhoneWave even after it starts sending messages into the past.
She can't resist an interesting experiment, so when Okabe makes membership the price of studying the PhoneWave, she joins his lab as Lab Member 004.
She fires back at every nickname Okabe gives her, from 'Assistant' to 'Christina', and bristles whenever Daru calls her a tsundere.
Her prickly front hides real hurt: she eventually admits to Okabe that her father came to hate her once her science outshone his.

kurisu-makise.backstory: Kurisu grew up close to her father, a physicist obsessed with time travel, and shared his fascination with his work. Her talent showed early, and once her work began to outshine his, he came to resent the daughter who was overtaking him. The two drifted apart and have not spoken properly for years. Kurisu jumped ahead a year at school in the United States, and by eighteen was a neuroscience researcher at Viktor Chondria University, specialising in memory, with a paper published in Science by eighteen. Behind the professional image she is a regular on the @channel message board. When the story begins she is in Akihabara, where her father, presenting himself as Doctor Nakabachi, is holding a seminar on time travel. It later emerges that on that day he tried to claim her time-travel theory as his own.

journey.summary: Okabe finds her apparently stabbed and bleeding at the seminar venue, only to run into her alive and well later that day. She treats him as a crank and takes him apart in front of an audience during a lecture.
Kurisu joins the Future Gadget Laboratory to study the PhoneWave, helps decode SERN's files, and helps establish the rules for sending 'D-Mails' to the past.

Using her memory research, she designs a way to send a person's memories back up to two days and completes the Time Leap Machine. Along the way she opens up to Okabe about her strained relationship with her father.

When SERN's agents storm the lab and Mayuri is killed, Kurisu sends Okabe back in time. In loop after loop she becomes his confidante, giving him phrases that will convince her past self to trust him and working out that the D-Mails need to be undone one by one.

She learns that saving Mayuri means returning to the world line where Kurisu died, and remembers her own stabbing in dreams. She tells Okabe to choose Mayuri and stops him from wearing himself down with more leaps; they confess their feelings before he makes the change.

Okabe travels back to the day of the seminar to save her and, in his first attempt, accidentally stabs her himself. On his second attempt he tricks his past self into believing she died, and Kurisu lives on in the Steins Gate world line. In the closing scene they cross paths in Akihabara, and she seems to remember something of the other world lines.

lessons.lesson: A good scientist changes her mind when the evidence does.
lessons.why: Kurisu starts out mocking time travel at Okabe's expense, yet once the PhoneWave proves itself she is the one who builds the Time Leap Machine.

lessons.lesson: Notice when someone is carrying too much.
lessons.why: On one of Okabe's many loops, Kurisu sees that something is badly wrong with him, gets him to tell her the truth, and gives him the tools to win her past self's trust next time.

lessons.lesson: Caring for someone can mean telling them to let you go.
lessons.why: Knowing that the world line where Mayuri lives is the one where she dies, Kurisu still tells Okabe to save Mayuri, and stops him from breaking himself trying to find a way around it.

relationships.name: Rintaro Okabe
relationships.detail: Kurisu and Okabe start out sparring over whether time travel is possible, become each other's closest confidant through his time leaps, and admit their feelings before he must give up their world line.

relationships.name: Mayuri Shiina
relationships.detail: Kurisu grows fond of Okabe's gentle childhood friend; once she learns that saving Mayuri means her own death, she urges Okabe to choose Mayuri.

relationships.name: Itaru 'Daru' Hashida
relationships.detail: The lab's hacker works alongside Kurisu on the PhoneWave and the time leap machine, and the two bicker constantly.

relationships.name: Suzuha Amane
relationships.detail: From their first meeting Suzuha distrusts Kurisu and warns Okabe to keep an eye on her; it later emerges that Suzuha came from the future to stop Kurisu's death.

relationships.name: Doctor Nakabachi
relationships.detail: The man behind the time-travel seminar is Kurisu's estranged father, who wants to claim her time-travel research as his own.

fights.title: The body in the Radio Kaikan
fights.summary: Okabe finds Kurisu apparently stabbed and bleeding on the floor, sends a text about it, and then discovers she is alive in a world that has quietly changed.

fights.title: Joining the Future Gadget Lab
fights.summary: Curious about the PhoneWave, Kurisu agrees to Okabe's terms and becomes Lab Member 004.

fights.title: Building the time leap machine
fights.summary: Kurisu completes a device that can send a person's memories as much as 48 hours back, just before SERN's agents raid the lab.

fights.title: Talking Okabe through despair
fights.summary: When every one of Okabe's rescues of Mayuri ends in her death, Kurisu gets him to tell her the whole truth and helps him think the problem through.

fights.title: Choosing Mayuri over herself
fights.summary: Kurisu remembers fragments of other world lines, tells Okabe to save Mayuri even though it will cost her life, and they admit they love each other.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: the encounter at the time-travel seminar and her apparent death.
She joins Okabe's lab as Lab Member 004.
Her time leap machine is finished, setting up the darker second half of the series.
Her farewell to Okabe as he shifts away from the world line she lives in.
Okabe finally saves her by reaching the Steins Gate world line.

qualities.detail: He turns up late to nearly everything, including the day he first meets Team 7, and casually keeps reading a paperback while he fights them in their test.
His bell test is designed to be impossible to pass alone; he only accepts Team 7 when Sasuke and Sakura break his order and share their lunch with a tied-up Naruto.
On the Land of Waves mission he lets the Demon Brothers think they've killed him so he can see how his students handle a real fight.
After the battle on the bridge, he honours the dying Zabuza's wish to be laid beside Haku, assuring him the two will end up together.
Under his headband he keeps a Sharingan given to him by a fallen teammate, and he uses it sparingly because it drains him badly; after his first duel with Zabuza he collapses from exhaustion.

kakashi-hatake.backstory: Kakashi's father, Sakumo Hatake, was a legendary Konoha ninja known as the White Fang. Sakumo abandoned a mission to save his comrades, was shamed for it, and took his own life, and young Kakashi, already a prodigy, decided that the mission must always come before the people on it. On a wartime operation under his teacher Minato Namikaze, his teammate Rin was captured and Obito Uchiha persuaded Kakashi to go back for her. When a cave-in crushed Obito, his dying gift was his Sharingan, which Rin transplanted into Kakashi's injured eye. Not long afterwards, Rin, who had been forcibly made the Three-Tails' jinchuriki as part of a plot against Konoha, threw herself in front of Kakashi's Lightning Blade and died. Kakashi went on to serve in the ANBU before becoming the instructor of a new team of genin.

journey.stage: Team 7 and the Land of Waves
journey.summary: Kakashi passes Team 7 only after they show they'll look out for each other. Their first escort mission turns deadly, and he reveals his Sharingan to fight Zabuza, ending the conflict with respect for his fallen opponent and Haku.
He puts Team 7 forward for the Chunin Exams over Iruka's doubts, and after Orochimaru marks Sasuke with a cursed seal, Kakashi teaches him the Chidori in the hope of steering his hunger for power.
Despite everything he tries, Kakashi can't get through to Sasuke, who leaves Konoha in search of power. It is a failure he carries into Part II.

Leading the new Team Kakashi with Naruto and Sakura, later joined by Sai, he unveils the Mangekyo Sharingan's Kamui, which sends targets into another dimension, and fights on the front line against Akatsuki, including the defeat of Hidan and Kakuzu.
Defending the village against Pain, Kakashi uses up all of his chakra and dies. He is brought back when Nagato, moved by Naruto, spends his remaining strength reviving everyone killed in the attack.

As a general in the war, Kakashi learns that the masked Tobi is Obito, alive and set on destroying the world that let Rin die. Encouraged by Naruto, he fights his old friend, later works alongside a repentant Obito, and borrows Obito's full Sharingan power for the battle against Kaguya after Obito sacrifices himself.
After the war Tsunade names him her successor. His first act as Sixth Hokage is to pardon Sasuke, and years later he hands the title to Naruto.

lessons.lesson: Rules matter less than the people you're with.
lessons.why: Kakashi passes Team 7 only because Sasuke and Sakura defy his order and feed Naruto. Putting comrades before rules is the choice his father was shamed for, and the one Obito taught him to respect.

lessons.lesson: An enemy is still a person.
lessons.why: Kakashi fights Zabuza to the end, yet once the battle is over he grants the dying man's request to be laid next to Haku.

lessons.lesson: Even a good teacher can't save everyone.
lessons.why: Kakashi gives Sasuke his signature technique and his time, but Sasuke still leaves Konoha; Kakashi doesn't give up on him, and pardons him years later as Hokage.

relationships.name: Naruto Uzumaki
relationships.detail: Kakashi becomes Naruto's jōnin instructor in Team 7, and only passes the team once Naruto's teammates break his rules to share their lunch with him.

relationships.name: Sasuke Uchiha
relationships.detail: As the other Sharingan user on Team 7, Sasuke trains privately with Kakashi before the Chūnin Exam finals and comes back wielding Chidori.

relationships.name: Sakura Haruno
relationships.detail: The third member of Team 7; Kakashi tests her with a genjutsu during the bell test and leads her through every mission that follows.

relationships.name: Obito Uchiha
relationships.detail: Dying under a rockslide in the war, Obito gave Kakashi his Sharingan. Years later Kakashi learns that the masked man behind the war is Obito himself.

relationships.name: Minato Namikaze
relationships.detail: The future Fourth Hokage led Kakashi's own childhood squad, and Kakashi later discovers that Naruto is Minato's son.

relationships.name: Itachi Uchiha
relationships.detail: When Itachi returns to the village, Kakashi faces him Sharingan to Sharingan and is put out of action by Tsukuyomi.

fights.title: Kakashi vs. Zabuza
fights.summary: Once he escapes the Water Prison, Kakashi copies Zabuza's water techniques one after another with his Sharingan and overwhelms him.

fights.title: Lightning Blade on the bridge
fights.summary: Kakashi pins Zabuza with his ninja hounds and strikes with Lightning Blade, but Haku throws himself in the way to shield his master.

fights.title: Kakashi vs. Itachi
fights.summary: Kakashi trades blows with Itachi Uchiha until the Mangekyō genjutsu Tsukuyomi leaves him unable to fight.

fights.title: Kakashi vs. Pain
fights.summary: Defending the village, Kakashi uses the last of his chakra on Kamui to help Chōji escape with vital intelligence, and dies from exhaustion.

fights.title: Kakashi vs. Obito
fights.summary: Inside Kamui's dimension, the two former teammates fight it out and end by impaling each other.

fights.title: Susanoo against Kaguya
fights.summary: Lent the power of Obito's eyes one last time, Kakashi forms a Susanoo to protect Sakura and joins Team 7's fight against Kaguya.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: Team 7's late-arriving instructor finally shows up.
The bell test ends with Kakashi passing Team 7 for choosing teamwork.
Kakashi Chronicles: how Kakashi lost an eye and inherited Obito's Sharingan.
Kakashi falls in battle against Pain; he is revived later in the arc.
After the war, Kakashi succeeds Tsunade as the Sixth Hokage.

strength.rank: Elite jōnin known as the Copy Ninja
strength.summary: With the Sharingan he received from Obito, Kakashi can mirror an enemy's techniques; he turns Zabuza's own water jutsu back on him and finishes fights with his Lightning Blade. He holds off Pain until his chakra gives out, and in the final battle against Kaguya, Obito's help lets him summon a Susanoo.

qualities.detail: He insists he is the mad scientist Hououin Kyouma, and hands everyone around him a dramatic nickname, from 'Christina' to 'Shining Finger'.
The whole mad-scientist act began as a way to look after Mayuri: when she was lost in grief over her grandmother, he declared her his 'hostage' so she would stay by his side.
Once the PhoneWave proves it can message the past, his first big test is sending lottery numbers back in time, without thinking much about the consequences.
When Suzuha is about to leave Tokyo, he makes her a lab member, plans a farewell party, and even sends a D-Mail to talk his past self into keeping her around.

rintarou-okabe.backstory: Rintaro Okabe is eighteen, in his first year at Tokyo Denki University, and styles himself the mad scientist Hououin Kyouma. He runs the Future Gadget Laboratory from a room above a television shop in Akihabara, building odd inventions with Mayuri Shiina, whom he has known since childhood, and his high-school friend Itaru 'Daru' Hashida, a skilled hacker. The over-the-top persona has a gentle origin: years earlier, when Mayuri lost her grandmother and seemed to be slipping into grief, Okabe announced that she was now his 'hostage' and built his whole eccentric character around keeping her close. He also has an ability he doesn't yet understand, letting him remember a timeline after it changes; he later calls it Reading Steiner and suspects it first appeared when he was a child. As the story opens, the lab is tinkering with a phone-operated microwave that reduces bananas to green jelly.

journey.summary: After finding Kurisu apparently stabbed, Okabe sends Daru a text and the world quietly rewrites itself around him. He works out that the PhoneWave can send messages into the past, learns that SERN has been running deadly time-travel experiments, and recruits Kurisu and the reporter Moeka into the lab.

Okabe starts sending D-Mails, and his friends ask to send their own: Moeka, Luka, who wants to have been born a girl, and Faris, whose message reshapes all of Akihabara. Kurisu completes a Time Leap Machine, but SERN's armed agents raid the lab, led by Moeka, and shoot Mayuri dead.

Okabe leaps back again and again, but Mayuri keeps dying. Suzuha reveals she is the time traveller John Titor and explains that he must reach a different world line. He helps her find her father, Daru, and then rewrites his own past to give her mission another chance, at a heavy cost.

To reach a world line in which the lab still owns the IBN 5100, he persuades each friend to cancel their D-Mail: Faris loses her father again, Luka goes back to being a boy, and Moeka's handler turns out to be the lab's landlord, Mr. Braun.

He realises that saving Mayuri means returning to the world line where Kurisu dies. After trying and failing to take Mayuri's place, he follows Kurisu's own urging, tells her he loves her, and erases the data, losing her.

Suzuha recruits him to save Kurisu and stop a future world war, but on his first attempt he accidentally stabs Kurisu himself. Mayuri slaps him out of his despair, a video left by his future self shows him the trick, and on his second try he takes a stab wound, fakes Kurisu's death with his own blood, and reaches the Steins Gate world line. Back in the present, he hands out lab badges and runs into Kurisu again in Akihabara.

lessons.lesson: Small shortcuts can add up to a disaster.
lessons.why: Each D-Mail seems harmless on its own, from lottery numbers to Faris's message, but together they set off the chain that kills Mayuri, and Okabe has to undo every one.

lessons.lesson: A silly act can be an act of love.
lessons.why: Hououin Kyouma looks like pure ego, yet he exists because Okabe wanted to keep a grieving Mayuri close.

lessons.lesson: After your worst failure, let someone pull you back up.
lessons.why: After stabbing Kurisu by mistake, Okabe refuses to try again until Mayuri slaps him and reminds him he has never given up on anyone. His next attempt is the one that works.

relationships.name: Mayuri Shiina
relationships.detail: Okabe has looked out for Mayuri since they were kids; when SERN's raid leaves her dead, he time leaps again and again trying to save her.

relationships.name: Kurisu Makise
relationships.detail: The young neuroscientist becomes the only person Okabe can fully confide in, and he falls in love with her before he has to pick between saving her and saving Mayuri.

relationships.name: Itaru 'Daru' Hashida
relationships.detail: Daru, Lab Member 003 and a friend since high school, is the hacker whose skills make the lab's D-Mail and SERN-network schemes possible.

relationships.name: Suzuha Amane
relationships.detail: The cheerful part-timer at the CRT shop is really a time traveller from a ruined 2036, and Daru's future daughter.

relationships.name: Moeka Kiryu
relationships.detail: The quiet woman hunting for the IBN 5100 is a SERN 'Rounder' who leads the raid on the lab and shoots Mayuri.

fights.title: The first world-line shift
fights.summary: After texting Daru that Kurisu has been stabbed, Okabe feels a strange lurch and finds that the streets, the seminar and even Kurisu's death have changed.

fights.title: Naming Reading Steiner
fights.summary: Okabe explains to Daru and Kurisu that he alone remembers the old world line after each change, and names the ability Reading Steiner.

fights.title: Leaping to save Mayuri
fights.summary: Sent back by Kurisu's time leap machine, Okabe tries escape after escape, but Mayuri dies every time, and he resolves to keep leaping until he wins.

fights.title: The failed rescue
fights.summary: Travelling back with Suzuha to save Kurisu, Okabe struggles with Nakabachi and ends up stabbing Kurisu himself.

fights.title: Deceiving his past self
fights.summary: Okabe lets Nakabachi stab him, stages the bloody scene his younger self once saw, and saves both Kurisu and Mayuri by reaching the Steins Gate world line.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: the self-proclaimed mad scientist's first brush with a changing world line.
SERN storms the lab and Mayuri is killed, turning the comedy into a tragedy.
Okabe chooses to save Mayuri and says goodbye to Kurisu.
His first attempt to save Kurisu goes horribly wrong.
Finale: Okabe reaches the Steins Gate world line.

qualities.detail: He takes the Hunter Exam with one purpose: to become a Blacklist Hunter with the resources to track the Phantom Troupe and recover his people's stolen eyes.
Faced with an old woman's 'quiz' on the road to the exam, he works out that it is a trick question, and stops Leorio from lashing out at her.
On the boat to the exam, a quarrel with Leorio escalates until the two head outside mid-storm to settle it with a duel, before Gon's rescue of a crewman interrupts them.

In the Trick Tower his scarlet eyes flare when his opponent shows off a spider tattoo, the Troupe's mark, but once the man is down Kurapika won't keep attacking a man with no fight left in him, even though it leaves the match unsettled.
After the exam he travels to Kukuroo Mountain with Gon and Leorio and trains to open the Zoldyck estate's heavy gate so they can bring Killua back.

kurapika.backstory: Kurapika was born into the Kurta Clan, a small people hidden away deep in the forests of Lukso. The Kurta are known for their irises, which turn a vivid scarlet when they feel strong emotion, and those eyes are prized as treasures by collectors in the outside world. Five years before the story begins, the criminal Phantom Troupe slaughtered the entire clan and took the eyes from the bodies, selling them through the black market. Kurapika is the only survivor. Since then he has lived for two goals: to make the Troupe pay and to recover every pair of his people's eyes. He set out to become a Hunter because a Hunter's license would give him access to the places, money and information he needs. Kurapika is calm and articulate on the surface, but anything connected to the Troupe sets off the scarlet in his eyes.

journey.summary: Kurapika meets Gon, Leorio and Killua, and his early rivalry with Leorio turns into friendship. His rage surfaces when a fellow candidate shows a spider tattoo, but he refuses to finish off a beaten opponent. Near the end, Hisoka quietly tells him he has information about the Troupe, and Kurapika passes.
He helps Gon and Leorio reach Killua at the assassin family's estate, then parts from his friends to pursue his own goal, knowing where to find Hisoka.

Turned away from a job, he meets a teacher who trains him in Nen. He builds chains on his right hand, and with his eyes scarlet he gains Emperor Time, which lets him use every type of Nen at full strength but takes an hour off his life for every second he uses it. He joins the Nostrade mafia family as a bodyguard.

When the Troupe descends on the city's underground auction, Kurapika faces Uvogin, one of their strongest fighters, and kills him. He later captures the Troupe's leader, Chrollo, seals his Nen with the Judgment Chain, and trades him for Gon and Killua. Afterwards he quietly gives last rites to the eyes he has recovered.

Later, he joins the Zodiacs on Leorio's recommendation once he learns that Prince Tserriednich holds the last of the Kurta eyes. He boards the voyage toward the Dark Continent as bodyguard to Prince Woble, using Emperor Time despite its toll on his lifespan; the arc remains unfinished as of November 2026 and is not covered by the 2011 anime.

lessons.lesson: Even justified rage needs a line you won't cross.
lessons.why: Kurapika's anger at anyone tied to the Troupe is real, yet in the Trick Tower he won't strike a defeated opponent, even when his teammates urge him to finish the match.

lessons.lesson: Revenge takes something from the person seeking it.
lessons.why: Emperor Time costs Kurapika an hour of life for every second he uses it, and he accepts that cost because of his goal.

lessons.lesson: Friends can remind you what you're really fighting for.
lessons.why: At a picnic after the Uvogin fight, Gon helps Kurapika see that he can now focus on his deeper goal: bringing his people's eyes home.

relationships.name: Gon Freecss
relationships.detail: Kurapika meets Gon on the boat to the Hunter Exam, and Gon later helps him refocus on recovering his clan's stolen eyes.

relationships.name: Leorio Paradinight
relationships.detail: Kurapika and Leorio start out bickering, get through the Hunter Exam side by side, and Leorio later helps him plan the hostage exchange in Yorknew.

relationships.name: Killua Zoldyck
relationships.detail: Killua joins the group during the exam and, in Yorknew, is the one who works out that the Troupe's mysterious 'chain user' must be Kurapika.

relationships.name: Uvogin
relationships.detail: The Phantom Troupe brawler is the first Troupe member Kurapika fights in his campaign of revenge, and the battle ends with Uvogin dead.

relationships.name: Chrollo Lucilfer
relationships.detail: Kurapika captures the leader of the Troupe that massacred the Kurta Clan and trades him for Gon and Killua, forbidding him from using Nen.

relationships.name: Hisoka
relationships.detail: After the exam bout in which Hisoka whispers to him and concedes, the magician meets Kurapika in Yorknew to trade information about the Troupe.

fights.title: Kurapika vs. Majitani
fights.summary: When his opponent flashes a spider tattoo, Kurapika's eyes blaze scarlet and he floors Majitani with one blow.

fights.title: Kurapika vs. Hisoka
fights.summary: In the final phase, Hisoka whispers something to Kurapika mid-fight and then concedes, sending Kurapika through.

fights.title: Kurapika vs. Uvogin
fights.summary: Outside Yorknew, Kurapika takes his revenge on the Troupe brawler, and the fight ends with Uvogin's death.

fights.title: Capturing Chrollo
fights.summary: With Gon and Killua held captive, Kurapika, Leorio and Melody take the Troupe's leader hostage to force an exchange.

fights.title: The hostage exchange
fights.summary: Kurapika sets his terms with Pakunoda and binds Chrollo so that he can neither use Nen nor contact the Troupe.

keyEpisodes.why: Debut: he meets Gon and Leorio and explains that he is after the Phantom Troupe.
First look at the Kurta Clan's scarlet eyes.
Turned away from Hunter work, Kurapika meets the man who will teach him Nen.
His first kill in his war on the Troupe.
Final episode: Kurapika is shown with recovered Kurta scarlet eyes.

strength.rank: Conjuration specialist built to hunt the Phantom Troupe
strength.summary: Kurapika conjures chains from his right hand, and whenever his scarlet eyes activate he switches to the Specialist category, where Emperor Time lets him use every Nen type at full strength, at a heavy cost to his life span. With that power he kills Uvogin, one of the Troupe's strongest fighters, and later takes the Troupe's leader hostage.

qualities.detail: He almost never shows strong feelings and wears a permanently blank face, because he knows that if his emotions ever hit 100% his power will break loose.
He thinks his psychic powers are unnecessary for everyday life, and joins the Body Improvement Club to get stronger the ordinary way, partly to impress his crush, Tsubomi.
When school delinquents kidnap him, he won't break free with his powers, sticking to his rule of not using them on people.
Even while the arrogant esper Teru is choking him, Mob realises that Teru's cruelty comes from the same insecurity about powers that he feels himself.
Far from athletic, he keeps training with the muscle-obsessed club, and later runs his school marathon to the finish line despite an injury.

shigeo-kageyama.backstory: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama has had enormous psychic powers since early childhood, and he learned that strong emotions make them dangerous. To stay in control he bottles up his feelings, which leaves him with a famously blank expression. Afraid of his own abilities and looking for guidance, he walked into the office of Arataka Reigen, a self-proclaimed psychic, about three years before the story begins, and Reigen hired him as an assistant. From Reigen, and from his childhood crush Tsubomi, Mob took on the idea that psychic power doesn't make anyone better than others and shouldn't be turned on people. When the series opens he is an eighth-grader at Salt Middle School, exorcising spirits for Reigen at 300 yen an hour alongside a younger brother, Ritsu, who is a star student. Buried inside him is an even greater power, ???%, which surfaces only when he is unconscious.

journey.summary: Mob handles the real spirits behind Reigen's jobs, picks the Body Improvement Club over the Telepathy Club, and, when the spirit Dimple tries to kill him, reaches 100% and blasts away Dimple's hold on his cult.

The esper Teru attacks him to prove that psychics are superior. Knocked out, Mob's ???% state flattens the school; once he wakes, Mob regrets breaking his own rule and rebuilds the building with his powers.
When the esper group Claw kidnaps Ritsu, Mob storms their branch with Teru. He beats their agents and breaks one of them with 100% rejection, then nearly loses control until Reigen talks him down.

Trapped in an esper's mental world for what feels like six months, he learns that people can change and forgives the girl who tormented him there. Realising Reigen has been using him, he ends their partnership, but when Reigen is publicly disgraced, Mob tells him he always knew he was a good person.

Claw's leader, Toichiro Suzuki, launches a takeover of the city. Mob befriends Claw's strongest esper, Serizawa, faces Toichiro himself, and in the end takes the man's runaway energy into his own body, which leaves a giant tree in place of a disaster.

He refuses to fight Dimple, who gives up his godhood to save everyone. On his way to confess to Tsubomi, Mob pushes a child out of a truck's path and is hit, and his ???% self runs wild. Ritsu and Reigen reach him, he accepts the feelings he had suppressed, and he finally confesses to Tsubomi. She turns him down, and in the final scenes Mob has his feelings and his power under his own command, and he is now the Body Improvement Club's vice-captain.

lessons.lesson: Being stronger doesn't make you better.
lessons.why: Teru treats his powers as proof that he is superior, and Mob's whole response is to insist they are just another trait, something Teru only accepts after their fight.

lessons.lesson: Bottled-up feelings don't disappear.
lessons.why: Mob's ???% turns out to be his suppressed self, and he stabilises only when he stops locking it away and accepts it as part of who he is.

lessons.lesson: You can walk away from someone and still believe in them.
lessons.why: Mob leaves Reigen once he sees he's being used, yet he is the first to stand by him when Reigen is exposed on television.

lessons.lesson: Effort counts even when you don't win.
lessons.why: Mob trains for the marathon hoping to place among the top ten and then confess, and he ends up around 74th, but his club later says his perseverance is what gave them the courage to protect him.

relationships.name: Arataka Reigen
relationships.detail: Mob works part-time for the con-artist psychic, who exploits his powers but also gives him the advice he lives by: powers are just one part of who he is.

relationships.name: Ritsu Kageyama
relationships.detail: Ritsu has long envied Mob's powers; when his own finally awaken, he is drawn into trouble and kidnapped by Claw.

relationships.name: Teruki Hanazawa
